title: Ari's reply blocks
description: A reply is Markdown. Where its content has a shape, Ari writes it as a fenced block whose info string is `ari:` and a kind, holding one JSON object, and the app draws it natively. A block the app doesn't recognise, or whose JSON doesn't parse, shows as its fenced text. Blocks are never spoken on a call. A name in the Markdown linked to what Ari keeps, `[Maya](memory:people/maya-lind)`, `[Lisbon weekend](motion:lisbon-weekend)` or `[the V&A guide](made:va-guide)`, is drawn with a dotted underline, and a tap opens a small card about it: who or what it is, a few facts, and its page. Ari links only what exists; a link to something that's gone reads as its words.

Picture.title: A picture
Picture.description: A picture Ari found on the web and kept with `keep_image`, as the events schema describes.

Verdict.description: Ari's take on one thing, drawn as a chip in bone and grey: `strong` filled, for the few best ("Must try"); `good` outlined in bone ("Recommended"); `neutral`, a plain fact in grey ("Best value"); `quiet`, a condition or a pass, in faint grey ("If you like heat", "Skip today"). Draw a tone you don't recognise as `neutral`.

label.description: A few words, in Ari's own voice.

Place.title: ari:place
Place.description: A place you might go, as a card with Directions. The app opens it in Maps.

note.description: What's useful now, such as "open till 17:45".

image.description: A picture of it, drawn small beside its name.

Choices.title: ari:choices
Choices.description: Short answers you might give next, to tap. A tap sends the label as an ordinary message; unlike an ask, nothing waits for it.

Motion.title: ari:motion
Motion.description: A compact line under a reply when Ari starts or changes a thing in motion, such as "Florence trip: booked the Uffizi". Tapping it opens the thing. Draw the line from the `MotionChange` with that version, or from the thing's title when there's none.

change.description: The thing's version the line is about.

Images.title: ari:images
Images.description: Pictures that help, such as a dish, a place or a thing to look for, a page at a time.

Picks.title: ari:picks
Picks.description: Ari's decisive picks, in order, numbered from 1: each with a picture, a price or a time, and one line on why.

title.description: A heading over them, such as "What I'd order".

detail.description: A price or a time, such as "£9.50" or "25 min".

File.title: ari:file
File.description: A file Ari made or changed for you to look at before it goes anywhere, such as a PDF, at one version. Draw it as a card with its name, kind, size and version that opens a preview (a PDF's pages) and shares it. `GET /v0/files/{file}` gives its versions and their attachments; fetch the bytes, exactly as made, with `GET /v0/attachments/{attachment}`. When a newer version exists, say so on the card. Feedback on a card is about its version.

Proposals.title: ari:proposals
Proposals.description: Changes Ari proposes and hasn't made, such as after reading a recording: each row one change, with Skip and its own verb. Nothing is applied until you tap the verb, and there's no accepting them all. A tapped verb sends your message with an `ari:decision` block, and Ari then makes that change and says so; the row shows its `done` line with Undo, which sends `undo`. Skip stays on your phone and never reaches Ari. Show how many are done, such as "1 of 3 done".

title.description: A heading over them, such as "What I'd change".

id.description: The row's id, unique in the block, which its decision names.

kind.description: What it changes, for its symbol: `calendar`, `draft` (a mail draft, never sent), `memory`, `desk`, `motion`, `wakeup` or `other`. Draw a kind you don't know as `other`.

title.description: The change, such as "Hold Thursday 15:00 for the CTO round".

detail.description: One line on why or how.

verb.description: Its button, a word or two, such as "Add", "Draft it" or "Keep".

done.description: What the row says once accepted, such as "Added to your calendar".

Decision.title: ari:decision
Decision.description: In your message, not Ari's: the row of an `ari:proposals` block you tapped. `accept` asks Ari to make exactly that change now; `undo` to take back what it made for it. The message's first line says the same in words, which is what the chat shows; the app leaves the block out of your bubble.

message.description: Ari's message that holds the block.

Attach.title: ari:attach
Attach.description: In your message, not Ari's: "Use in draft" on a file Ari showed. Ari attaches exactly that version, which waits in its workspace at `shown/<file>/v<version>/<name>`, to the mail draft it's for, and never sends it. The message's first line says the same in words; the app leaves the block out of your bubble.

Table.title: ari:table
Table.description: A table that fits a phone: one row per thing, its name with a line under it, at most two short values, and Ari's verdict as a chip at the end. `columns` heads the name, then each value, then the verdict when rows carry one.

detail.description: A line under the name, such as what's in a dish.

Number.title: ari:number
Number.description: A number that matters, large, with what it is and what it's made of, such as "Estimated for two", "£47".

context.description: What it's made of, in a line or two.

CalendarEvent.title: ari:event
CalendarEvent.description: An event Ari suggests, with Add: the app opens the phone's own event sheet, filled in, and you add it there.

start.description: RFC 3339 with its offset, such as `2026-11-27T19:30:00+00:00`.

all_day.description: On the start's day, with no time.

on_calendar.description: Ari already put it on your calendar: the card says so instead of offering Add.

DeskItem.title: ari:desk
DeskItem.description: A card waiting on the Desk, shown in the chat as the same card with its own buttons, marked as also on the Desk: a draft has Open in Mail, Change… and Drop (never Send), a question its options. One item, two views: answering it in either place answers it. Draw it from the Desk; once it's off the Desk, a quiet line says it's settled.

Person.title: ari:person
Person.description: Someone Ari keeps a page about, as a small card: their monogram, who they are, and their page.

Made.title: ari:made
Made.description: A page Ari made, as a card: its cover, title, summary, when it was made or last updated, and Open. Draw it from the `Made` with that id; once it's forgotten, a quiet line says so.
